messages:
maria: quick check — eom demo next Tue (APAC 10am SGT). vendor just said they can't guarantee extra H100 slots. Can we get a soft quota bump or borrow from EU pool? cc @alex @jamie

alex: short answer: we have 12 spare A500s but no H100. If demo strictly needs H100 (L40s) we need vendor swap or preemptible fallback. I opened PR to bump standby quota for apac-standby: https://git/repo/pull/432 — needs IAM tag fix.

jamie: pinged procurement liaison — @vendor-liaison any update on H100 ETA? :eyes:

vendor-liaison: vendor update: quoted +2 weeks for H100 racks; can offer temporary A500 borrow for 48h as a stopgap. If you take A500 we can wire power and drivers by Fri EOD.

sam: A500 is fine *if* we scope the perf hit. Also need a quick CR on infra PR — @alex can you add the required IAM + cost_center tag? otherwise billing will hold.

alex: yep will push a fix today. Terraform snippet for the temporary pool (WIP):
```hcl
resource "redwood_gpu_pool" "apac_temp_borrow" {
  region = "apac-southeast1"
  sku    = "a500"
  count  = 12
  tags = {
    cost_center = "demo_eom_q2"
    owner       = "maria"
  }
}
```

kai: FYI billing: set cost_center = "demo_eom_q2" or finance will block the charge. @maria can you confirm the cost center?

maria: confirmed, will set tag. Also updating route policy to add eu-west fallback if latency < 120ms so demos don't fail hard.

procure-bot: Purchase request #789 opened for temporary A500 borrow, estimated ETA 06/10. Assigned to vendor-liaison.

jamie: noted, thanks. I'll approve the infra PR once the IAM tag and cost_center are present. :thumbsup:

alex: pushed the IAM and tags change, assigned back to @jamie for CR.

jamie: approved, merging now. :shipit:

sam: test deploy to staging scheduled tonight 23:30 SGT. I'll watch logs and smoke test the demo flow (prefix caching + batching).

maria: thanks all — if vendor moves the H100 earlier please update this thread. Also flag if any latency regressions show up from A500 fallback. End of thread.
